description.p: FastSync keeps a folder in sync with Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or MEGA, both ways, with every file available offline. Log in through your browser, choose the folders, and it runs from the tray.

Changes are noticed straight away: edits on your computer through inotify, and edits in the cloud through each service's own change feed, without listing the whole tree again. If both sides changed a file, both copies are kept. Files removed in the cloud go to a trash folder instead of being deleted, and a run that would delete too many files stops and asks first.
